title: 1. One thing after another
about: Blocks play from top to bottom. Put Maya's blocks in an order that makes sense.

title: 2. Ask the player
about: Ask the player for their name, then use it in what Sam says.

title: 3. Two ways to go
about: Add a Choice so the player decides where Robo goes. Tap Map to see the paths.

title: 4. Keep count
about: Count the stars Robo catches with a number, then use an If to change the ending.

title: 5. Fix the story
about: This story has three mistakes. Tap each ! to read what is wrong, then fix it.
